initial_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: game sprite atlas. Re-create the most recent MetalGarurumon sprite atlas, preserving the same recognizable silver-and-blue quadrupedal mechanical wolf character, polished Digimon Adventure anime cel shading, and arrangement of exactly 6 columns by 3 rows (18 poses). Landscape 1536x1024. Row 1 front/down, row 2 facing right, row 3 facing up/back. Columns in each row: idle; left-front/right-rear legs stepping forward; opposite walking gait; crouched attack anticipation; forward bite/claw attack; braced open-mouth casting with missile hatches open. Keep every entire wolf, ears, claws and tail inside its own cell with wide clear gaps, same foot baseline per row. True transparent background and clean alpha, no solid backdrop, no checkerboard painted into pixels, no ground shadows. No text, no grid lines, no detached projectiles. Keep four-legged anatomy in every pose. This is a game asset to restore the previously generated atlas for integration into Godot.
final_edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Rearrange the referenced MetalGarurumon atlas into a PORTRAIT sprite sheet with EXACTLY THREE COLUMNS AND SIX ROWS, 18 sprites total. Canvas 1024x1536 portrait. Preserve the recognizable silver-blue quadrupedal MetalGarurumon design and polished cel-shaded anime style. Critical: each of the 18 character drawings MUST be SMALL, taking at most 65% of its cell width and 70% of its cell height, centered in its cell, with at least 17% completely transparent padding on all sides. Complete tails, ears, muzzles, wings, claws must be fully visible, never crossing cell borders or touching neighbors. Wide transparent gutters. Row 1: FRONT/DOWN facing idle, walk left step, walk right step. Row 2: FRONT/DOWN facing attack anticipation, attack strike, skill casting. Row 3: facing RIGHT side-view idle, walk left step, walk right step. Row 4: facing RIGHT side-view attack anticipation, attack strike, skill casting. Row 5: facing UP/BACK idle, walk left step, walk right step. Row 6: facing UP/BACK attack anticipation, attack strike, skill casting. This is 6 rows with 3 poses each, NOT 3 rows of 6. Row directions absolutely consistent. Back view shows no face. All poses quadrupedal, same size for the same viewing angle, paws on the same baseline within each row. Distinct alternating leg placement for the two walk frames, wind-up for attack anticipation, open mouth/paw lunge for strike, braced stance and missile doors open for cast. No projectiles, no effects. Genuinely transparent alpha backdrop, no gradients, no ground shadows, no checkerboard drawn into pixels. No grid lines, no labels, no text. Prioritize generous transparent separation and fully contained small characters over filling space.
